title: On Braverman-Kazhdan's asymptotic Hecke algebra for inner forms of $\mathrm{GL}_n$
summary: We study Braverman-Kazhdan's asymptotic Hecke algebra $\mathcal{J}(G)$ for inner forms $G$ of $p$-adic $\mathrm{GL}_n$. We show that $\mathcal{J}(G)$ and the property for a $G$-representation to extend to a $\mathcal{J}(G)$-module are defined over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}_\ell}$, and hence make sense in the context of the categorical local Langlands correspondence.
